# Changelog

All notable changes to Bubble Tea Designer will be documented here.

Format based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/).
Versioning follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [1.0.0] - 2025-10-18

### Added

- Documentation-only skill adapted for gcon's TUI architecture
- gcon-specific reference docs (design patterns, architecture best practices, example designs)
- Component taxonomy and pattern templates mapped to gcon's view archetypes
- References to gcon helpers (`CreateViewBase`, `TableClickDelegate`, `NewGCPSpinner()`, etc.)

### Notes

- Earlier experimental Python-based tooling (functions like `comprehensive_tui_design_report()`, keyword databases, and code scaffolding generators) was removed prior to this release
- This skill ships only documentation and reference material for designing Bubble Tea views in gcon

## [Unreleased]

### Planned

- Expand documentation for custom Bubble Tea components and advanced layouts
- Refine archetype definitions and example mappings
- Add more design patterns and fully worked example designs
